resources.string: Unavailable: not provided by the system
Normal mode (HDR disabled or Settings not selected)

Custom range: 1.0–8.0×. Applied to selected HDR screens when you release the slider. 1.0× requests no extra highlight headroom without disabling the HDR window. This is not a whole-screen brightness multiplier or a measure of the highlights used by an image. The system and display determine the actual ratio, which may be lower than requested. The reading belongs to the current display, not other screens.
Android 14 can read the actual ratio when provided by the system, but cannot manually adjust window headroom. Android 15+ supports adjustment. This device uses the system automatic value.
Keep HDR window mode for selected screens
Current display supports HDR, system API %1$d
This display or system does not support this HDR window feature. Android 14+ and an HDR display are required. Saved selections are retained.

Selected foreground screens keep HDR window mode, even with SDR artwork. This may increase battery use and heat, and may change brightness or color on some devices. Results depend on the system, display and power settings. SDR content is not automatically converted to HDR; native HDR artwork carries additional highlight information. Requests are retained during transitions. The original window mode is restored when leaving selected screens or moving to the background. Unsupported devices fall back to normal display.
HDR enabled: battery use and heat may increase. SDR content is not automatically converted to HDR.
